response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS throwing_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '')), hand_shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, player_count, 1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(h.player_count) AS total_count, AVG(h.share) AS average_share, AVG(h.share - a.share) AS average_excess FROM hand_shares AS h CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE h.share > a.share;
